site_metadata.name: Aryan's Portfolio
site_metadata.description: Interactive 3D portfolio with AI assistant, admin platform, and mini games
site_metadata.role: Aspiring DevSecOps Engineer • Computer Science Student

/.name: Home / Main Portfolio
/.description: Immersive 3D hero page with overlay navigation system
features: Full-viewport 3D Spline scene background with interactive elements
Animated overlay navigation with glassy morphism UI
Sections: Home hero, About, Achievements, Education, Organizations, Projects, Contact, Message
Performance settings: Auto (device-aware), Lite (reduced motion), High (full effects)
Mobile notice for optimal viewing experience
Announcement popup system with target filtering (main/ai/both)

/AI.name: AI Assistant Page
/AI.description: Full-screen AI chatbot with Spotify integration
features: Full-screen Gemini-powered chatbot with context about Aryan's profile
Persistent conversation history with local storage
Markdown rendering support (bold, lists, links, inline code)
Typing indicator and slow-processing UX hints
Quick question suggestions for common queries
Spotify integration section ('Tune Your AI Vibes')
Ambient particle field background with gradient glows
3D tilt effect on chat card (reduced on mobile)
Announcement popup scoped to AI target
Privacy banner with link to AI privacy policy
Feedback capture system for AI responses

/cv.name: Curriculum Vitae
features: Professional CV layout with personal information
Educational background with institutions and dates
Responsive design for various screen sizes

/login.name: Admin Login
features: Redirect to admin dashboard on success

/message-to-aryan.name: Direct Messaging
/message-to-aryan.description: Contact form for sending messages to Aryan

/ai-privacy.name: AI Privacy Policy
/ai-privacy.description: Privacy statement for AI assistant usage
features: Collapsible sections for different privacy aspects

/terms.name: Terms of Service
/terms.description: Terms and conditions for site usage

/admin-dashboard.name: Admin Dashboard Landing
features: Automatic redirect to main admin panel

/admin.name: Admin Control Panel
features: Authority management: canEditSections, canAccessDev, banned flags
- Achievements Editor: CRUD operations for achievements with certificates
- Education Editor: Manage educational timeline entries
- Organizations Editor: Manage organization memberships and roles
- Announcements Manager: Create/edit/delete announcements with target selection
- Admin Profile: View/edit own profile, change password with re-authentication
- Developer Operations: Owner-only access to advanced tools
- Messages Moderation: Review and manage contact form submissions
Audit logging for all administrative actions
Login logs with filtering and pagination

/admin/sign-requests.name: Signature Request Reviewer
features: List all signature requests with status
Embedded Spline scene with URL configuration

Overlay.description: Main navigation and content overlay system
features: Section switching via top navigation bar
Call-to-action buttons: Contact Me (mailto), View Achievements, GitHub link
Certificate open in Google Drive (Open button)
Active item tracking with scroll/mouse position
Institution logos (Brawijaya University, SMA Negeri 1 Singosari)
Organization details with roles and dates
Local storage for scores and settings
Invitation to play while section is under development
Supported platforms: Email, LinkedIn, Instagram, GitHub
Floating mode: Shows on all routes except /AI and /admin/login
Markdown rendering (bold, lists, links, inline code)
Keyboard shortcuts: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline, Esc to close
Search functionality for Tracks and Playlists
'Preview only' filter for tracks with 30s samples
Recent query chips for quick access
No full playback or Web Playback SDK
Full chess game implementation using chess.js
Multiple game states (menu, playing, game over)
Used on /AI page for ambient effects
